sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一座葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首了，体内血液也被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来她的凶手费尽心机来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸（Jane Doe）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字——艾达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“罪案档案呈现”（Casefile Presents）的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: Alcatraz Prison had since been repaired to a workable condition.
sentences.zh: 此后，恶魔岛监狱已被修复至可运作的状态。

sentences.en: The battle scars of Bernie Coy's 1946 violent failed escape remained visible throughout the cell house.
sentences.zh: 伯尼·科伊（Bernie Coy）在1946年那场暴力越狱失败后留下的战斗痕迹，在整个牢房区依然清晰可见。

sentences.en: Areas of the floor were chipped, cracked, and faded black from where grenades had detonated.
sentences.zh: 由于手榴弹曾在这里爆炸，部分地面有崩裂、碎裂以及被熏黑的痕迹。

sentences.en: In response to the Battle of Alcatraz that resulted in the deaths of two correctional officers, the imposing prison tightened its grip on the inmates.
sentences.zh: 由于“恶魔岛战役”导致两名狱警身亡，这座威严的监狱进一步加强了对囚犯的管控。

sentences.en: The stricter control was used to readjust the kinds of rebellious attitudes and behaviours that led to the siege in the first place, and aimed to crush all thoughts of escape.
sentences.zh: 这种更严格的控制旨在纠正导致当年围攻事件的各种叛逆态度和行为，并企图粉碎所有越狱的念头。

sentences.en: Minor infractions, seen as disrespectful or agitating, were met with harsh punishment.
sentences.zh: 任何被视为不尊重或煽动性的微小违规行为，都会遭到严厉的惩罚。

sentences.en: Rumours spread amongst inmates that guard tower snipers had been ordered to shoot to kill anyone trying to break out.
sentences.zh: 囚犯中流传着这样的谣言：守卫塔上的狙击手已经接到命令，可以对任何试图越狱的人格杀勿论。

sentences.en: In the ten years following the Battle of Alcatraz, no inmates attempted an escape.
sentences.zh: 在“恶魔岛战役”之后的十年里，没有一个囚犯尝试越狱。

sentences.en: It seemed the temptation had been overtaken by fear of death.
sentences.zh: 对死亡的恐惧似乎已经战胜了越狱的诱惑。

sentences.en: However, the thought never left the minds of battered inmates who resented Alcatraz and sought freedom.
sentences.zh: 然而，这个念头从未在那些痛恨恶魔岛并渴望自由的饱受折磨的囚犯脑海中消失过。

sentences.en: As days dragged on and felt like eternity, inmates found solace in passing the time by dreaming up elaborate escape plans
sentences.zh: 随着日子一天天过去，度日如年，囚犯们通过构思精密的越狱计划来打发时间并寻找慰藉，

sentences.en: and thinking of ways to get out of Alcatraz once and for all.
sentences.zh: 并思考着彻底逃离恶魔岛的方法。

sentences.en: Every morning at 6.30am, inmates woke to the piercing sound of the morning whistle.
sentences.zh: 每天早上6点30分，囚犯们都会在刺耳的早晨哨声中醒来。

sentences.en: They rose, made their beds, cleaned up their cells, and washed themselves in preparation for breakfaSt.
sentences.zh: 他们起床、整理床铺、打扫牢房，并梳洗干净，准备吃早餐。

sentences.en: At 7.15am, a second whistle blew, signalling the start of the count.
sentences.zh: 早上7点15分，第二声哨声响起，标志着清点人数的开始。

sentences.en: Inmates stood at the bars of their cell while a passing guard took a head count.
sentences.zh: 囚犯们站在各自牢房的铁栏杆旁，过路的狱警则进行人数清点。

sentences.en: It was no different on the morning of June 12th, 1962.
sentences.zh: 1962年6月12日的早晨也没有什么不同。

sentences.en: Inmates slant against the bars as guards walked past counting.
sentences.zh: 当狱警们边走边清点人数时，囚犯们斜靠在栏杆上。

sentences.en: Oddly, the guards realised they were missing three.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，狱警们发现他们少了三个人。

sentences.en: Thinking they must have miscalculated, they walked back along the corridors and recounted.
sentences.zh: 他们以为是自己算错了，便沿原路返回走廊重新清点。

sentences.en: But they got the same result.
sentences.zh: 但他们得到的结果还是一样。

sentences.en: Three were missing.
sentences.zh: 少了三个人。

sentences.en: Logical explanations were considered firSt.
sentences.zh: 首先考虑的是合理的解释。

sentences.en: Maybe the three inmates were still in a deep sleep and failed to hear the morning whistle.
sentences.zh: 也许这三个囚犯还在熟睡，没有听到早上的哨声。

sentences.en: Maybe they were unwell in bed and needed medical attention.
sentences.zh: 也许他们生病卧床，需要医疗救助。

sentences.en: Guards quickly paced by the cells to determine who wasn't upstanding.
sentences.zh: 狱警们迅速在牢房旁踱步，以确定是谁没有站起来。

sentences.en: In cell 158, an inmate was curled up in bed still asleep.
sentences.zh: 在158号牢房里，一名囚犯蜷缩在床上，还在睡觉。

sentences.en: Reaching into the cell, a guard patted the pillow next to the inmate's head in an attempt to wake him up.
sentences.zh: 一名狱警将手伸进牢房，拍了拍囚犯头旁边的枕头，试图叫醒他。

sentences.en: But the inmate didn't stir.
sentences.zh: 但那名囚犯毫无动静。

sentences.en: The guard then tapped the inmate's head.
sentences.zh: 接着，狱警敲了敲囚犯的头部。

sentences.en: Still no response.
sentences.zh: 依然没有任何反应。

sentences.en: The guard yelled out.
sentences.zh: 狱警大声喊了起来。

sentences.en: We either have a dead man or a dummy in the cell block.
sentences.zh: 我们牢房区里要么躺着个死人，要么就是个假人。

sentences.en: I can't wake him up.
sentences.zh: 我根本叫不醒他。

sentences.en: Other guards walked over to the cell to investigate.
sentences.zh: 其他狱警也走过来查看情况。

sentences.en: One yelled at the inmate to get up.
sentences.zh: 其中一人大声命令那名囚犯起来。

sentences.en: Still no response.
sentences.zh: 依然没有回应。

sentences.en: Impatient, the guard reached in and slapped the sleeping inmate hard across the face.
sentences.zh: 失去耐心的狱警伸出手，狠狠地打了那个正在睡觉的囚犯一耳光。

sentences.en: Horrified guards leapt back when the inmate's decapitated head rolled straight off the pillow and onto the floor.
sentences.zh: 当那个囚犯被砍断的头颅从枕头上直接滚落到地上时，惊恐万状的狱警们吓得连连后退。

sentences.en: It's a dummy, a guard called out.
sentences.zh: 是个假人，一名狱警大喊道。

sentences.en: They pulled the blankets off the cot and exposed bunched up clothing that had been tucked underneath to give the illusion of a sleeping body.
sentences.zh: 他们扯下行军床上的毯子，露出了塞在下面以营造熟睡假象的一堆揉成团的衣服。

sentences.en: A small square hole just wide enough to squeeze through was found dug into the back wall of the cell.
sentences.zh: 人们在牢房的后墙上发现了一个刚刚够塞进身体的小方形洞口。

sentences.en: Guards rushed frantically around the cell house.
sentences.zh: 狱警们在牢房区内疯狂地四处奔跑。

sentences.en: They discovered two more cells with dummies in the beds and holes dug out of the back walls.
sentences.zh: 他们发现另外两个牢房的床上也有假人，后墙上也凿出了洞。

sentences.en: The three inmates belonging to each of the cells were missing.
sentences.zh: 属于这三个牢房的囚犯全部失踪了。

sentences.en: When the guards rushed to raise the alarm, Alcatraz inmate Alan West casually leant against his cell door and called out.
sentences.zh: 当狱警们冲过去拉响警报时，恶魔岛囚犯艾伦·韦斯特（Alan West）漫不经心地靠在牢房门上大声喊道。

sentences.en: You may as well lock me up.
sentences.zh: 你们干脆把我也关起来吧。

sentences.en: I planned the entire escape.
sentences.zh: 整个越狱计划是我策划的。

sentences.en: Serving 10 years for transporting stolen vehicles across state lines,
sentences.zh: 因为跨州运送失窃车辆而正在服刑10年，

sentences.en: 33-year-old Alan West was relocated to Alcatraz in 1957 after a failed escape attempt at his previous state penitentiary in Florida.
sentences.zh: 33岁的艾伦·韦斯特在佛罗里达州的前州立监狱越狱未遂后，于1957年被转移到了恶魔岛。

sentences.en: Alcatraz inmate AZ-1130, West quickly earned a reputation as an aggressive tough guy who always got in trouble with other inmates.
sentences.zh: 作为恶魔岛编号AZ-1130的囚犯，韦斯特很快就树立了好斗硬汉的声誉，总是和其他囚犯惹麻烦。

sentences.en: After a punishing stint in D-block, the prison's treatment unit for troublemakers featuring solitary and isolation cells, West emerged with a strong desire to escape Alcatraz,
sentences.zh: 在经历了一段惩罚性的D区（该监狱专门关押惹事生非者的隔离禁闭区）禁闭生活后，韦斯特表现出了逃离恶魔岛的强烈愿望，

sentences.en: but had yet to come up with a plan on how to do so.
sentences.zh: 但尚未想出具体该如何实施的计划。

sentences.en: The main cell house of Alcatraz prison consisted of four large cell blocks, A, B, C and D blocks.
sentences.zh: 恶魔岛监狱的主牢房区由四个大型牢房区组成，即A区、B区、C区和D区。

sentences.en: D-block was the only one closed off from the main cell house.
sentences.zh: D区是唯一与主牢房区隔离开来的区域。

sentences.en: The cells in A-block were mostly used for storage, except when certain prisoners needed to be separated from other inmates, but were not being punished.
sentences.zh: A区的牢房大多用作储藏室，除非某些囚犯需要与其他犯人隔离但又未受惩罚时才会使用。

sentences.en: The lines of cells in B and C blocks housed the majority of the general prison population.
sentences.zh: B区和C区的成排牢房关押着绝大多数的普通犯人。

sentences.en: Each cell block was three storeys higher with rows of cells on each level.
sentences.zh: 每个牢房区都有三层楼高，每层都有成排的牢房。

sentences.en: Every moment of the day, guards patrolled the ground floor corridors between cell blocks, as well as the balconies of each of the higher levels.
sentences.zh: 在一天中的每一个时刻，狱警们都会在牢房区之间的底楼走廊以及每个高层楼的走廊进行巡逻。

sentences.en: On the top of each cell block was an attic-like space directly under the prison ceiling.
sentences.zh: 每个牢房区的顶部都是一个紧挨着监狱天花板、类似阁楼的空间。

sentences.en: This narrow space was surrounded at its edges by bars, and was in full view of guards patrolling the galleries.
sentences.zh: 这个狭窄空间四周边缘环绕着栏杆，并且完全处于在走廊巡逻的狱警的视线范围之内。

sentences.en: It was an open space filled with pipes and vents that was rarely visited.
sentences.zh: 这是一个堆满管道和通风口且鲜有人访的开阔空间。

sentences.en: As such, it had been neglected and become very dirty and dusty, and the ceiling paint had faded.
sentences.zh: 因此，这里一直被忽视，变得非常脏乱、布满灰尘，天花板上的漆也剥落了。

sentences.en: So after his punishment in D-block, Alan West was assigned to go up to the top of the cell blocks to clean up, and to repaint the ceiling of the main cell house.
sentences.zh: 所以在结束了D区的惩罚后，艾伦·韦斯特被派往牢房区的顶部进行清理工作，并重新粉刷主牢房区的天花板。

sentences.en: Whilst up there, he caught sight of something intriguing.
sentences.zh: 正是在那里，他瞥见了一些有趣的东西。

sentences.en: There were multiple wide ventilation shafts in the ceiling that let out onto the prison roof.
sentences.zh: 天花板上有多个宽大的通风井，通向监狱屋顶。

sentences.en: Most had been filled in with concrete long ago, making them completely inaccessible.
sentences.zh: 大部分通风井很久以前就已经用水泥封死，使其完全无法通行。

sentences.en: However, West noticed one ventilation shaft had not yet been filled in.
sentences.zh: 然而，韦斯特注意到有一个通风井尚未被封死。

sentences.en: But there were several steel bars inside the duct criss-crossing over each other.
sentences.zh: 但在管道内部有几根交叉纵横的钢筋。

sentences.en: They were strong, and would be near impossible to cut through with meagre makeshift prison tools.
sentences.zh: 它们非常结实，用简陋的监狱自制工具几乎是不可能将其切断的。

sentences.en: It seemed the ventilation shaft was a false hope.
sentences.zh: 看来这个通风井不过是空欢喜一场。

sentences.en: But then, West noticed the edges of the vent had been screwed into the concrete ceiling.
sentences.zh: 但随后，韦斯特注意到通风口的边缘是用螺丝固定在水泥天花板上的。

sentences.en: He started to believe, with the right tools, he might be able to unscrew and remove the entire vent structure, and pull the whole thing out in one piece.
sentences.zh: 他开始相信，只要有合适的工具，他或许就能拧下并拆除整个通风结构，把整件东西完整地拉出来。

sentences.en: That would save him from having cut through the bars inside.
sentences.zh: 这样他就省去了切割里面钢筋的麻烦。

sentences.en: The exposed tunnel would lead him straight onto the prison roof, and onwards to freedom.
sentences.zh: 裸露出的通道将直接把他带到监狱屋顶，进而走向自由。

sentences.en: West couldn't investigate the vent properly, though, as the top of the cell block could be seen by guards patrolling the nearby gun gallery.
sentences.zh: 不过，韦斯特无法对通风口进行仔细检查，因为牢房区顶部会被附近枪械走廊巡逻的狱警看到。

sentences.en: If they caught sight of him eyeing the vent, they'd probably fill it with concrete immediately as a precaution.
sentences.zh: 如果他们看到他在盯着通风口，很可能会为了以防万一而立即用水泥把它封上。

sentences.en: There was no way he could work on unscrewing the massive vent out of the roof whilst up there without being noticed.
sentences.zh: 他绝对不可能在上面不被察觉的情况下，动手把巨大的通风口从屋顶上卸下来。

sentences.en: Even if he worked on it slowly over time, tinkering with the vent whenever he wasn't being watched, a stray guard could notice the tampering damage and have the vent filled.
sentences.zh: 即使他花时间慢慢地干，趁没人注意时鼓捣一下通风口，也可能会有路过的狱警发现遭到破坏的痕迹并把通风口封死。

sentences.en: As promising as it looked, it was too high a risk to do anything about it, and West had to let it go.
sentences.zh: 尽管它看起来很有希望，但这样做的风险太高了，韦斯特不得不放弃。

sentences.en: It tortured him that he had found a potential exit, but he couldn't take advantage of it.
sentences.zh: 找到了潜在的出口却无法利用，这让他感到备受折磨。

sentences.en: 32-year-old John Anglin and his 31-year-old younger brother Clarence robbed a bank in Alabama with a toy pistol, netting them almost $20,000 in cash.
sentences.zh: 32岁的约翰·安格林（John Anglin）和他的31岁弟弟克拉伦斯（Clarence）用一把玩具手枪在亚拉巴马州抢劫了一家银行，抢得近2万美元现金。

sentences.en: But they were apprehended five days later, and after their convictions, the brothers were placed in separate prisons.
sentences.zh: 但他们在五天后被捕，定罪后，这对兄弟被分别关押在不同的监狱里。

sentences.en: John was sent to Florida, and Clarence was sent to Kansas.
sentences.zh: 约翰被送往佛罗里达州，克拉伦斯则被送往堪萨斯州。

sentences.en: It was while serving time in Florida that John Anglin met Alan West, before West was shipped off to Alcatraz after his botched escape attempt.
sentences.zh: 正是在佛罗里达州服刑期间，约翰·安格林结识了艾伦·韦斯特，后来韦斯特因越狱未遂被押往恶魔岛。

sentences.en: After West was moved to Alcatraz, John Anglin was transferred as well.
sentences.zh: 韦斯特被转移到恶魔岛后，约翰·安格林也被转移了。

sentences.en: He was sent to Kansas, where he was reunited with his brother Clarence.
sentences.zh: 他被送往堪萨斯州，在那里与弟弟克拉伦斯团聚。

sentences.en: John got a job in the prison's bakery in Kansas.
sentences.zh: 约翰在堪萨斯州的监狱面包房里找到了一份工作。

sentences.en: When a guard spotted him straining to push a trolley carrying two supposedly empty bread boxes into the prison elevator, the guard ordered him to stop and open the lid.
sentences.zh: 当一名狱警发现他正吃力地推着一辆装着两个据称是空的面包箱的手推车进入监狱电梯时，狱警命令他停下并打开盖子。

sentences.en: Hidden inside was John's brother Clarence, attempting to escape.
sentences.zh: 藏在里面的是企图逃跑的约翰的弟弟克拉伦斯。

sentences.en: The failed bread box breakout rewarded the siblings a ticket each to Alcatraz, their transfer record stating the move was to ensure safer custody.
sentences.zh: 这次失败的面包箱越狱行动让兄弟俩每人获得了一张前往恶魔岛的“门票”，他们的调动记录上写着此举是为了确保更安全地看押。

sentences.en: John Anglin arrived first, in October 1960, becoming Alcatraz inmate AZ-1476.
sentences.zh: 约翰·安格林于1960年10月率先抵达，成为了恶魔岛编号AZ-1476的囚犯。

sentences.en: Clarence arrived soon after, in January 1961, as Alcatraz inmate AZ-1485.
sentences.zh: 克拉伦斯不久后于1961年1月抵达，成为了恶魔岛编号AZ-1485的囚犯。

sentences.en: The Anglin brothers arrived to the fearsome Alcatraz prison without the kind of dangerous reputation that preceded their cellmates.
sentences.zh: 安格林兄弟抵达这座令人闻风丧胆的恶魔岛时，并没有像他们的同监犯人那样带着危险的名声。

sentences.en: They were nobodies, who had no connection to any well-known crime circles.
sentences.zh: 他们只是无名小卒，与任何声名狼藉的犯罪集团都没有联系。

sentences.en: They didn't have a hardcore, violent criminal history to boast about.
sentences.zh: 他们没有可以吹嘘的强硬、暴力的犯罪历史。

sentences.en: The big crime that put them behind bars was considered soft, but was committed with a toy weapon because they didn't want to hurt anybody.
sentences.zh: 把他们送进监狱的那场大罪被认为性质较轻，而且作案时使用的是玩具武器，因为他们不想伤害任何人。

sentences.en: In an act of uncharacteristic leniency,
sentences.zh: 出于罕见的宽容，

sentences.en: Alcatraz staff permitted the Anglin brothers to be placed in adjacent cells and sit together during meal time.
sentences.zh: 恶魔岛的工作人员允许安格林兄弟被安排在相邻的牢房，并在吃饭时坐在一起。

sentences.en: What was known to other inmates in Alcatraz was that the Anglin brothers were failed escapees, always looking for a way out.
sentences.zh: 恶魔岛的其他囚犯都知道，安格林兄弟是越狱未遂者，一直在寻找逃跑的办法。

sentences.en: John Anglin was soon reacquainted with Alan WeSt.
sentences.zh: 约翰·安格林很快与艾伦·韦斯特重新取得了联系。

sentences.en: West was still obsessed with the thought of escape, and after learning about the Anglin brothers' failed attempt, he realised he and the siblings shared mutual interests.
sentences.zh: 韦斯特仍然沉迷于越狱的想法，在得知安格林兄弟越狱失败的经历后，他意识到自己和这对兄弟有着共同的利益。

sentences.en: Trusting the Anglins, West told them of his prior discovery, the ventilation shaft on top of the cell block.
sentences.zh: 出于对安格林兄弟的信任，韦斯特将他先前的发现——牢房区顶部的通风井告诉了他们。

sentences.en: A lengthy and quiet discussion followed about how they could possibly pull off a successful escape.
sentences.zh: 随后，他们进行了长时间而安静的讨论，商量着如何才能成功实施越狱。

sentences.en: The group clicked immediately.
sentences.zh: 这几个人一拍即合。

sentences.en: They were all on the same page, and they hatched the beginnings of an escape plan around removing the duct and climbing out onto the prison roof.
sentences.zh: 他们的想法完全一致，并围绕着拆除管道并爬上监狱屋顶制定了越狱计划的雏形。

sentences.en: From there, they would climb down the prison building and make a break for San Francisco City across the bay.
sentences.zh: 从那里，他们将顺着监狱大楼爬下去，并朝着海湾对面的旧金山市突围。

sentences.en: Alcatraz inmate AZ-1441,
sentences.zh: 作为恶魔岛编号AZ-1441的囚犯，

sentences.en: 35-year-old bank robber Frank Morris had been in and out of trouble with the law since he was 13 years old.
sentences.zh: 35岁的银行劫匪弗兰克·莫里斯（Frank Morris）从13岁起就一直与法律作对，麻烦不断。

sentences.en: Throughout his troublesome youth,
sentences.zh: 在他充满麻烦的青少年时期，

sentences.en: Morris adapted his high intelligence to serve him more practically.
sentences.zh: 莫里斯调整了他极高的智商，使其服务得更加实用。

sentences.en: His understanding and observation of others made him incredibly cunning and shrewd.
sentences.zh: 他对他人心理的理解和观察力使他变得极其狡猾和精明。

sentences.en: He put his skills to the test by trying to break out of every institution that held him.
sentences.zh: 他通过试图逃离每一个关押过他的机构来检验自己的技能。

sentences.en: When he was finally sent to the end of the prison line,
sentences.zh: 当他最终被送到监狱链条的尽头——

sentences.en: Alcatraz, his official occupation listed on his prison documents was escape artiSt.
sentences.zh: 恶魔岛时，他的官方档案上列出的职业是“越狱专家”。

sentences.en: Prison authorities considered Morris a psychopath, a loner who preferred solitary activities and who kept his thoughts to himself.
sentences.zh: 监狱当局认为莫里斯是一个精神病患者、一个独行侠，喜欢独自活动并将自己的想法深藏不露。

sentences.en: Inmates saw Morris as the most intelligent person in Alcatraz, a genius, which made him stand out to Alan West, who just happened to be his cell neighbour.
sentences.zh: 囚犯们则视莫里斯为恶魔岛上最聪明的人、一个天才，这使他在艾伦·韦斯特眼中脱颖而出，而韦斯特恰好是他的隔壁邻居。

sentences.en: Previous escapes by other inmates throughout the years of Alcatraz had failed for being too hasty with little in the way of planning.
sentences.zh: 多年来，其他囚犯之前的越狱行动都因过于草率且缺乏规划而告吹。

sentences.en: West needed someone who could outsmart Alcatraz, an experienced escapee who was patient and clever.
sentences.zh: 韦斯特需要一个能够智胜恶魔岛的人，一个有耐心、聪明的经验丰富的越狱者。

sentences.en: Someone who could foresee and solve various problems in their planning and not leave anything to chance.
sentences.zh: 一个能够在规划中预见并解决各种问题而不把任何事情留给运气的人。

sentences.en: Which made Frank Morris the perfect person to join West and the Anglin brothers' escape.
sentences.zh: 这使得弗兰克·莫里斯成为加入韦斯特和安格林兄弟越狱行动的绝佳人选。

sentences.en: And by December 1961,
Morris was brought up to speed.
sentences.zh: 莫里斯已经了解了最新情况。

sentences.en: He became invaluable to the group.
sentences.zh: 他成了这个团伙中不可或缺的人。

sentences.en: Morris spearheaded some of the more elaborate and brilliant ideas in the escape and resolved a lot of the problems that stood between the inmates and freedom.
sentences.zh: 莫里斯牵头提出了越狱中一些更为精妙绝伦的想法，并解决了许多横亘在囚犯与自由之间的难题。

sentences.en: When it was built in the 1930s,
sentences.zh: 在20世纪30年代建造时，

sentences.en: Alcatraz prison was one of the largest concrete structures in the world.
sentences.zh: 恶魔岛监狱是世界上最大的混凝土结构建筑之一。

sentences.en: The solid, impenetrable concrete exterior added to the prison's escape-proof reputation.
sentences.zh: 坚固、刀枪不入的混凝土外观增添了这座监狱“无法逃脱”的美誉。

sentences.en: However, by the 1960s, the building had been battered for decades by corrosive seawater that had worn down the structure's integrity.
sentences.zh: 然而，到了20世纪60年代，这座建筑几十年来一直受到具有腐蚀性的海水的侵蚀，结构完整性已经受损。

sentences.en: Cracks were beginning to appear throughout the cell house, creating structural vulnerabilities.
sentences.zh: 牢房区的各处开始出现裂缝，造成了结构上的薄弱点。

sentences.en: Spending upwards of 23 hours a day in one cell, with not much else to do but stare at the walls, inmates noticed the many cracks slowly appearing before any guards did.
sentences.zh: 囚犯们每天在一间牢房里度过长达23小时以上的时间，除了盯着墙壁看没有太多别的事可做，因此他们比任何狱警都更早注意到慢慢出现的许多裂缝。

sentences.en: West, Morris and the Anglin brothers scratched at the cracks in their cells and realised that the supposedly solid concrete around them actually flaked away rather easily
sentences.zh: 韦斯特、莫里斯和安格林兄弟抠着他们牢房里的裂缝，意识到他们周围那些本应坚固的混凝土其实很容易剥落，

sentences.en: when chipped at with a sharp tool.
sentences.zh: 只要用尖锐的工具凿一凿就会脱落。

sentences.en: At the base of the back wall of each cell was a small vent measuring 6 by 10 inches.
sentences.zh: 每个牢房后墙的底部都有一个6乘10英寸大小的小通风口。

sentences.en: The escaping inmates' plan was to remove the grill that covered the vent, widen the vent hole until they could fit their bodies through it, and then crawl into the utility corridor
sentences.zh: 越狱囚犯的计划是拆除覆盖通风口的铁栅栏，扩大通风口直到他们的身体能够钻过去，然后爬进

sentences.en: behind it.
sentences.zh: 其后方的公用设施走廊。

sentences.en: The utility corridor was a sealed corridor that was rarely used, filled with piping and scaffolding.
sentences.zh: 公用设施走廊是一条封闭且极少使用的走廊，里面布满了管道和脚手架。

sentences.en: It was an easy climb up the three levels in the utility corridor to the top of the cell block and to the ventilation shaft they hoped would be their exit from the cell house.
sentences.zh: 顺着公用设施走廊的三层楼往上爬很容易就能到达牢房区顶部，以及他们希望成为逃离牢房区出口的通风井。

sentences.en: To dig out their cell walls, they needed to construct decent digging tools.
sentences.zh: 为了凿开牢房墙壁，他们需要制作像样的挖掘工具。

sentences.en: The group noticed that the guards counted knives after each meal to ensure none had been stolen, but they neglected to count the less threatening utensils, so they were easily
sentences.zh: 这伙人注意到，狱警在每顿饭后都会清点餐刀以确保没有一把被偷，但他们忽略了清点那些威胁较小的餐具，因此他们轻而易举地

sentences.en: able to pocket the metal spoons they used for their meals.
sentences.zh: 就能把吃饭用的金属勺子揣进兜里。

sentences.en: They bent the bowl of the spoon back and forth until it snapped off, then sharpened the broken end of the handle and used it to dig and chip at the concrete around the vent
sentences.zh: 他们来回掰动勺子凹陷的部位直到它断裂，然后将手柄断裂的一端磨尖，并用它来挖掘和敲凿牢房后方

sentences.en: in the backs of their cells.
sentences.zh: 水泥墙上的通风口周围。

sentences.en: Digging occurred at night, during the music hour.
sentences.zh: 挖掘是在夜间音乐时间进行的。

sentences.en: This was when inmates with instruments were permitted to play before lights out.
sentences.zh: 这是指在熄灯前，允许有乐器的犯人演奏的时间。

sentences.en: During music hour, the cell house was filled with the ear-splitting, echoing sound of dozens of instruments playing different songs all at once.
sentences.zh: 在音乐时间里，牢房区回荡着刺耳的声音，几十种乐器同时演奏着不同的曲子。

sentences.en: It easily masked the sound of the escaping inmates chipping and carving out the walls in their cells.
sentences.zh: 这很容易掩盖越狱犯人在牢房墙壁上凿墙雕刻的声音。

sentences.en: The Anglin brothers worked together as one team and West and Morris as the other.
sentences.zh: 安格林兄弟作为一组一起合作，韦斯特和莫里斯作为另一组。

sentences.en: As one inmate dug, the other acted as a lookout and each night the roles were reversed.
sentences.zh: 一个犯人挖掘时，另一个担任风吹草动的望风员，每天晚上两人轮换角色。

sentences.en: They flushed concrete chunks down the toilets in their cells and swept dust out into the corridor.
sentences.zh: 他们把混凝土块冲进牢房的马桶里，把灰尘扫进走廊。

sentences.en: They'd passed larger piles of broken-up concrete to other inmates who worked outdoors, where the pieces were discreetly scattered outside.
sentences.zh: 他们把较大块的碎混凝土交给在户外工作的其他犯人，这些碎片被悄悄地散落到外面。

sentences.en: The other inmates helped without question.
sentences.zh: 其他犯人毫无疑问地伸出援手。

sentences.en: There was a code amongst the prison population.
sentences.zh: 犯人群体中存在着一种暗号。

sentences.en: If you could help another inmate escape, you did it, even if you weren't participating in the escape yourself.
sentences.zh: 如果你能帮助另一个犯人越狱，你就会去做，即使你自己没有参与越狱。

sentences.en: In the early days, they initially hid the small damage they were creating in their cell walls with strategically placed boxes or hanging clothes.
sentences.zh: 在早期，他们最初用精心放置的箱子或挂着的衣服来掩盖在牢房墙壁上造成的微小破坏。

sentences.en: But as days turned to weeks, the damage became far more obvious.
sentences.zh: 但随着日子一天天变成几周，破坏变得越来越明显。

sentences.en: They worried their work could be easily exposed in a simple random cell search.
sentences.zh: 他们担心，在一次简单的随机查房中，他们的工作很容易暴露。

sentences.en: The excitement of escaping was blinding them to obvious flaws in their planning.
sentences.zh: 越狱的兴奋让他们对计划中的明显漏洞视而不见。

sentences.en: They needed to slow down and think things through.
sentences.zh: 他们需要放慢脚步，仔细思考。

sentences.en: Be smarter than the prison.
sentences.zh: 比监狱更聪明。

sentences.en: After putting their heads together, they came up with a solution.
sentences.zh: 大家集思广益后，想出了一个解决办法。

sentences.en: They each built fake vent grills out of cardboard and painting canvas.
sentences.zh: 他们用硬纸板和画布各自制作了假的通风栅栏。

sentences.en: Using paint collected from inmates who were permitted to make art, they painted the fake cardboard grills the same colour as the ones in their cells.
sentences.zh: 利用从被允许艺术创作的犯人那里收集来的颜料，他们把纸板假栅栏画得和牢房里的一模一样。

sentences.en: During times they couldn't work on digging, they covered their handiwork with the fake grill.
sentences.zh: 在不能进行挖掘的时候，他们用假栅栏盖住自己的手艺。

sentences.en: Passing guards were fooled.
sentences.zh: 路过的警卫被骗过了。

sentences.en: The fake grills were near exact replicas of the real thing.
sentences.zh: 这些假栅栏几乎是真货的精确复制品。

sentences.en: After months of digging, it was Morris and John Anglin who burst through the backs of their cells firSt.
sentences.zh: 经过几个月的挖掘，莫里斯和约翰·安格林首先冲破了牢房的后墙。

sentences.en: They had expanded the 6 by 10 inch vent gap into a sizable
sentences.zh: 他们把6乘10英寸的通风口扩大成了一个相当大的

sentences.en: 10 by 14 inch hole.
sentences.zh: 10乘14英寸的洞。

sentences.en: Yet, there was no sense in going into the utility corridor and climbing up to the ventilation shaft just yet.
sentences.zh: 然而，现在进入公用走廊并爬上通风井还没有意义。

sentences.en: Their shadowy figures would most certainly be seen or heard by night shift guards.
sentences.zh: 他们昏暗的身影肯定会被夜班警卫看到或听到。

sentences.en: Besides, another major problem had arisen they needed to fix before they got to work on the ventilation shaft.
sentences.zh: 此外，在着手处理通风井之前，还出现了一个需要他们解决的重大问题。

sentences.en: After lights out at 9.30pm, guards walked down the corridors and did a body count.
sentences.zh: 晚上9点30分熄灯后，警卫会走过走廊清点人数。

sentences.en: This happened all through the night, on the hour, every hour.
sentences.zh: 整夜都在发生这种情况，按点进行，每小时一次。

sentences.en: It was a major problem for the escapees.
sentences.zh: 这对越狱者来说是个大问题。

sentences.en: They couldn't sneak out the back of their cell to get to work on the ventilation shaft as their absence would be noticed during the count.
sentences.zh: 他们不能偷偷溜出牢房后部去通风井工作，因为清点人数时会发现他们不在。

sentences.en: They needed to create the illusion that they were still in bed asleep when they weren't.
sentences.zh: 他们需要制造一种假象，即他们不在的时候仍然躺在床上睡觉。

sentences.en: It would require something smarter than just stuffing pillows under their blankets to look like there was a body under there.
sentences.zh: 这需要比仅仅在毯子下面塞枕头看起来像有人躺在下面更聪明的办法。

sentences.en: After thinking hard for a solution,
sentences.zh: 经过苦思冥想寻找解决方案后，

sentences.en: Frank Morris approached inmates who were artists and inquired about what colours of paint you would have to mix to create a flesh-coloured tone.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克·莫里斯找到身为艺术家的犯人，询问必须混合什么颜色的颜料才能调出肉色。

sentences.en: Then, using papier-mâché around a wire frame, a mixture of concrete and plaster dust, sticky toothpaste and soap mixed into the consistency of clay and the flesh-coloured paint.
sentences.zh: 然后，在铁丝框架周围使用纸浆、混凝土和石膏粉的混合物、粘性牙膏和搅拌成黏土稠度的肥皂以及肉色颜料。

sentences.en: Morris and the group managed to create dummy heads that were amazingly detailed and lifelike, good enough to trick a passing guard looking into a dark cell during nightly counts.
sentences.zh: 莫里斯和这群人设法制作出了细节惊人、栩栩如生的假人头，足以在夜间查房时骗过往黑牢房里看的路过警卫。

sentences.en: Clarence Anglin worked in the prison barbershop and he was able to smuggle out bunches of cut hair that they stuck on the dummy heads.
sentences.zh: 克拉伦斯·安格林在监狱理发店工作，他能够走私出一束束剪下的头发，贴在假人头上。

sentences.en: They even gave the dummy heads eyebrows and eyelashes.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至给假人头加上了眉毛和睫毛。

sentences.en: The escaping inmates also needed to work out a way to take out the ventilation shaft on top of the cell block.
sentences.zh: 越狱的犯人们还需要想出一个办法，拆除牢房上方顶部的通风井。

sentences.en: Without being seen by guards.
sentences.zh: 不被警卫发现。

sentences.en: Alan West was still assigned to paint the top of the cell block and he intentionally swept dust and dried paint flakes off the edge causing them to rain down
sentences.zh: 阿兰·韦斯特仍然被指派粉刷牢房顶部，他故意把灰尘和干颜料片从边缘扫落，让它们像雨一样落下

sentences.en: on the lower tier balconies and to the polished ground floor below.
sentences.zh: 落到下层的阳台和下面光亮的地面上。

sentences.en: Guards became frustrated at the mess so West approached them with a solution.
sentences.zh: 警卫对这片混乱感到沮丧，于是韦斯特带着解决方案找到了他们。

sentences.en: He suggested he should hang heavy blankets around the top of the cell block to create a wall that would stop the dust and paint flakes from falling off the edge.
sentences.zh: 他建议在牢房顶部周围挂上厚重的毯子，筑起一堵墙，挡住灰尘和颜料片从边缘掉落。

sentences.en: The unsuspecting guards gave West permission to do this.
sentences.zh: 毫戒心的警卫批准了韦斯特的做法。

sentences.en: The hanging blankets gave the escaping inmates complete privacy to work on removing the ventilation shaft and luckily for them the blankets were permitted to hang up there
sentences.zh: 悬挂的毯子为越狱犯人拆除通风井提供了完全的隐私，幸运的是，毯子被允许挂在那里

sentences.en: for months without issue.
sentences.zh: 几个月都没有出现问题。

sentences.en: Once Frank Morris and Clarence Anglin completed their dummy heads they tucked bunched up clothing under their blankets and rested the head on their pillow giving the illusion
sentences.zh: 一旦弗兰克·莫里斯和克拉伦斯·安格林完成了他们的假人头，他们就把一团团衣物塞进毯子下，把头靠在枕头上，营造出一种

sentences.en: of a sleeping body.
sentences.zh: 正在熟睡的身体的错觉。

sentences.en: Passing guards were completely fooled.
sentences.zh: 路过的警卫完全被骗过了。

sentences.en: They were convinced that Frank Morris and Clarence Anglin were asleep in their cells each night when in reality they were on top of the cell block hiding behind
sentences.zh: 他们深信弗兰克·莫里斯和克拉伦斯·安格林每天晚上都在牢房里睡觉，而实际上他们在牢房顶部躲在

sentences.en: the walls of blankets securing their exit out of the prison.
sentences.zh: 毯子墙后面，确保他们能逃出监狱。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 罪案档案节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期赞助商节目以支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持罪案档案继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: During their childhood growing up in the
sentences.zh: 在他们度过的童年时期，

sentences.en: Florida swamps the Anglin brothers visited local swimming holes and built makeshift boats and rafts out of any material they could find.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州的沼泽地里，安格林兄弟参观了当地的游泳洞，并用他们能找到的任何材料建造了临时船只和木筏。

sentences.en: They developed a strong understanding of raft building and how to negotiate currents.
sentences.zh: 他们对建造木筏和如何应对水流有了深刻的理解。

sentences.en: Many years later as their grand escape from Alcatraz plan progressed they suggested that the group construct a raft and life jackets to increase their chances of surviving
sentences.zh: 多年后，随着他们宏大的阿尔卡特拉兹越狱计划的推进，他们建议集体建造一艘木筏和救生衣，以增加他们生还的几率

sentences.en: the trek across the San Francisco
sentences.zh: 横渡旧金山

sentences.en: Bay to the mainland.
sentences.zh: 湾前往大陆。

sentences.en: The only waterproof item on Alcatraz that the inmates had access to were old
sentences.zh: 阿尔卡特拉兹岛上囚犯们唯一能接触到的防水物品是旧的

sentences.en: US Army issue olive coloured rubber raincoats.
sentences.zh: 美军发配的橄榄色橡胶雨衣。

sentences.en: These were given to inmates working outdoors to ward off the icy ocean breeze.
sentences.zh: 这些雨衣发给在户外工作的犯人，以抵御冰冷的海洋微风。

sentences.en: The raincoats were durable and strong and the ideal fabric for an inflatable raft and life jackets.
sentences.zh: 雨衣经久耐用，是充气木筏和救生衣的理想面料。

sentences.en: Other inmates handed the group their raincoats and then lied to the guards stating that they had misplaced lost or others had stolen their coats.
sentences.zh: 其他犯人把自己的雨衣交给这群人，然后对警卫谎称他们的雨衣放错地方、丢了或者被别人偷了。

sentences.en: There was an overabundance of them so the guards would hand the inmates a new one without question.
sentences.zh: 雨衣过剩，所以警卫会毫不犹豫地给犯人发一件新的。

sentences.en: Over time the escapees amassed more than three dozen raincoats that they stored secretly on top of the cell block.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，越狱者积累了三十多件雨衣，并将它们秘密存放在牢房顶部。

sentences.en: A 1962 issue of the magazine
sentences.zh: 1962年的一期杂志

sentences.en: Popular Mechanics gave the inmates the pattern they needed to design the life jackets.
sentences.zh: 《大众机械》为犯人提供了设计救生衣所需的纸样。

sentences.zh: 另一些人则认为他们毫无机会，坚信他们的尸体正躺在海湾底部。

sentences.en: The escape did change the atmosphere in the prison, though.

sentences.en: Suddenly, the fortress that stripped inmates of hope and humanity, that aimed to punish, not rehabilitate, no longer seemed so imposing and fearful.

sentences.en: What followed was a renewed sense of hope amongst inmates who had lost it long ago.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的是，那些久失希望的犯人心中重新燃起了希望。

sentences.en: If Morris and the Anglin brothers can do it, so can I.
sentences.zh: 如果莫里斯和安格林兄弟能做到，我也能。

sentences.en: Prison officials increased the frequency of random cell and body searches, and constantly relocated inmates to different cells.
sentences.zh: 监狱官员增加了随机搜查牢房和身体的频率，并不断将犯人重新安置到不同的牢房。

sentences.en: But the prison's reputation had been tarnished, inside and out.
sentences.zh: 但监狱的名誉无论在内还是在外都已受损。

sentences.en: But neither John nor Clarence ever reached out.
sentences.zh: 但约翰和克拉伦斯从未露面。

sentences.en: Either they were smart enough to go underground, keep a low profile, and make no contact.
sentences.zh: 要么是他们足够聪明，隐姓埋名、保持低调、断绝一切联系。

sentences.en: Or they were dead.
sentences.zh: 要么就是他们已经死了。

sentences.en: Three months after the escape, September
sentences.zh: 逃狱三个月后，即1962年9月

sentences.en: 13th, 1962, a fisherman a half mile out from
sentences.zh: 13日，一名距离恶魔岛

sentences.en: Alcatraz, reeled in his line, and brought up a barnacle-encrusted human skull with its lower jaw missing.
sentences.zh: 半英里的渔夫收起鱼线时，钓上了一个长满藤壶、下颌骨缺失的人类头骨。

sentences.en: Alcatraz prison officials boasted this was proof the escapees had drowned.
sentences.zh: 恶魔岛监狱官方吹嘘说，这证明逃犯们已经溺水身亡。

sentences.en: But dental records showed that the skull didn't belong to any of the inmates.
sentences.zh: 但牙齿档案显示，这个头骨并不属于任何一名逃犯。

sentences.en: Further tests showed the skull belonged to someone much older than any of the escapees.
sentences.zh: 进一步的测试表明，该头骨属于一个比任何逃犯都要年长得多的人。

sentences.en: The air and water search concluded on June
sentences.zh: 海空搜寻工作于6月

sentences.en: 22nd, 11 days after the escape.
sentences.zh: 22日结束，即逃狱后第11天。

sentences.en: Days, weeks, months, and years passed with no breakthroughs.
sentences.zh: 日子、周、月、年一天天过去，始终没有取得突破。

sentences.en: But there were plenty of rumours, assumptions, and myths.
sentences.zh: 但各种传闻、猜想和神话却层出不穷。

sentences.en: Over the years, the Anglin family claimed to have received numerous unexplained birthday letters and postcards that had writings similar to that of John and Clarence.
sentences.zh: 多年来，安格林一家声称收到了许多来历不明的生日信件和明信片，上面的字迹与约翰和克拉伦斯相似。

sentences.en: But as none of the letters had postmarked dates, it was difficult to confirm when they were sent.
sentences.zh: 但由于这些信件都没有邮戳日期，很难确定它们是什么时候寄出的。

sentences.en: Oddly, John and Clarence's mother had a bunch of flowers delivered on her birthday each year.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，约翰和克拉伦斯的母亲每年生日都会收到一束送上门的花。

sentences.en: The sender remained anonymous.
sentences.zh: 寄件人匿名。

sentences.en: Years later, the Anglin family were given a photograph from an old friend of John and
sentences.zh: 多年后，安格林一家从约翰和

sentences.en: Clarence.
sentences.zh: 克拉伦斯的一位老朋友那里得到了一张照片。

sentences.en: The photo showed two men standing near a rock purportedly taken on a farm in Brazil.
sentences.zh: 照片显示两个男人站在一块石头旁，据称拍摄于巴西的一个农场。

sentences.en: A forensic expert confirmed the photograph was taken in 1975 and asserted that the men in the photo were more than likely John and Clarence Anglin.
sentences.zh: 法医专家证实这张照片拍摄于1975年，并断言照片中的男子很有可能就是约翰和克拉伦斯·安格林。

sentences.en: However, the men are wearing sunglasses and have facial hair.
sentences.zh: 然而，照片中的男子戴着太阳镜，留着面部毛发。

sentences.en: The photo was also taken at a distance, so it couldn't be confirmed without a doubt that it was John and Clarence.
sentences.zh: 而且照片是远距离拍摄的，因此无法百分之百确认那就是约翰和克拉伦斯。

sentences.en: In 1973, John and Clarence Anglin's mother passed away.
sentences.zh: 1973年，约翰和克拉伦斯·安格林的母亲去世了。

sentences.en: The FBI attended the funeral, and witness accounts claim that two tall and unusual looking women wearing long dresses and heavy makeup
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局出席了葬礼，据目击者称，有两名身材高大、长相奇特的妇女穿着长裙、化着浓妆

sentences.en: attended the service, said nothing to anybody, and disappeared before the FBI could speak to them.
sentences.zh: 出席了追悼会，对谁都没说话，并在联邦调查局找她们谈话之前消失了。

sentences.en: An old institutional questionnaire filled out by an incarcerated 20-year-old Frank Morris listed the things he would wish for if he were granted three wishes.
sentences.zh: 一份由一名20岁服刑犯人弗兰克·莫里斯填写的旧监狱问卷，列出了如果他能获得三个愿望时他所希望得到的东西。

sentences.en: His wishes were...
sentences.zh: 他的愿望是……

sentences.en: It may never be known if any of Morris' wishes came true.
sentences.zh: 莫里斯的愿望是否成真，或许永远不得而知。

sentences.en: After 17 years of active investigation, the FBI reached a formal conclusion on the escape from Alcatraz.
sentences.zh: 经过17年的积极调查，联邦调查局对恶魔岛逃狱案作出了正式结论。

sentences.en: They determined, through limited evidence and expert opinion, that the likelihood the three inmates survived their escape was highly unlikely,
sentences.zh: 他们通过有限的证据和专家意见断言，三名囚犯在逃亡中幸存的可能性极其渺茫，

sentences.en: and that no credible evidence in the US or overseas had emerged to suggest otherwise.
sentences.zh: 并且在美国或海外都没有出现任何可信的证据来表明情况并非如此。

sentences.en: The FBI officially ended their involvement in the investigation on December 31st, 1979, and handed the case to the United States Marshal Service,
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局于1979年12月31日正式结束了对该案的调查，并将案件移交给美国法警局，

sentences.en: a federal government agency that specialises in searching for wanted individuals and prison escapees.
sentences.zh: 这是一个专门搜寻通缉犯和越狱逃犯的联邦政府机构。

sentences.en: Open to the possibility that the inmates were able to survive their well-thought-out escape, the Marshals continued to follow leads in every American state, as well as overseas.
sentences.zh: 秉持着囚犯可能在精心策划的逃亡中幸存下来的可能性，法警们继续在全美各州以及海外追踪线索。

sentences.en: In 2010, after one promising tip, they exhumed an unmarked grave claimed to belong to one of the escapees.
sentences.zh: 2010年，根据一条有希望的线索，他们掘开了一座据称属于其中一名逃犯的无名坟墓。

sentences.en: But no positive identification was made.
sentences.zh: 但没有得出明确的身份确认。

sentences.en: For years since the disappearance, authorities have received thousands of leads, tips, and claims of sightings of the three men.
sentences.zh: 自失踪以来的多年里，当局收到了数千条关于这三名男子的线索、举报和目击报告。

sentences.en: The investigation went all the way to South America after a tipster informed authorities that they saw the Anglin brothers in a bar in Brazil.
sentences.zh: 在一位知情人向当局通报在巴西的一家酒吧看到了安格林兄弟后，调查一路延伸到了南美洲。

sentences.en: Investigators visited the bar and conducted multiple interviews, with no result.
sentences.zh: 调查人员走访了该酒吧并进行了多次走访，但无功而返。

sentences.en: Many tests have been conducted under similar circumstances of the escape.
sentences.zh: 在与逃狱相似的环境下，人们进行了许多测试。

sentences.en: Rafts made of raincoats have been sailed across the bay.
sentences.zh: 用雨衣制作的木筏被划着横渡海湾。

sentences.en: Thousands of people have successfully swum the distance between Alcatraz Island and the San Francisco mainland in varying conditions.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的人在各种天气条件下成功游过了从恶魔岛到旧金山大陆的距离。

sentences.en: Studies of the bay's currents have been inconclusive.
sentences.zh: 对海湾水流的研究一直没有得出定论。

sentences.en: Results depend on the exact time the men set sail from Alcatraz Island, something that will never be known.
sentences.zh: 结果取决于这群人从恶魔岛起航的确切时间，而这一点永远不得而知。

sentences.en: Various witnesses claim to have met the men throughout the years, but without proof, these statements can't be verified.
sentences.zh: 各种目击者声称这些年来遇到过这些人，但在没有证据的情况下，这些说法无法得到证实。

sentences.en: The escape triggered debate and discussions in Washington DC between Congress and prison officials.
sentences.zh: 这次逃狱引发了华盛顿特区国会与监狱官员之间的辩论和讨论。

sentences.en: Alcatraz was created to be a deterrent to 1930s public enemy gangster crime.
sentences.zh: 建立恶魔岛的初衷是为了震慑20世纪30年代的江洋大盗和黑帮犯罪。

sentences.en: But times had changed.
sentences.zh: 但时代变了。

sentences.en: Questions were asked if the prison had outlived its usefulness and become a dated relic of a time long ago.
sentences.zh: 人们开始质疑这座监狱是否已经失去了它的效用，变成了远古时代的过时遗迹。

sentences.en: The prison was inspected and it was concluded that to fix the structural damage that would cost taxpayers millions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 经对监狱进行检查，得出的结论是修复结构损坏将耗费纳税人数百万美元。

sentences.en: Plus, the cost of keeping an inmate in Alcatraz was upwards of $13 per day, compared to $5 per day at other state prisons.
sentences.zh: 此外，在恶魔岛维持一名囚犯的成本高达每天13美元以上，而其他州立监狱则为每天5美元。

sentences.en: The interest in keeping Alcatraz prison open was fading.
sentences.zh: 维持恶魔岛监狱开放的兴趣正在消退。

sentences.en: On December 17th, 1962, six months after Morris and the Anglin brothers escaped, two other inmates broke out of Alcatraz.
sentences.zh: 1962年12月17日，即莫里斯和安格林兄弟逃狱六个月后，另外两名囚犯从恶魔岛逃出。

sentences.en: With only crude water wings made out of blown-up surgical gloves stuffed up the sleeves of their shirts, the inmates dived into the bay and started swimming.
sentences.zh: 这两名囚犯仅凭塞在衬衫袖子里充气的医用手套做成的简易水翼，跳入海湾开始游泳。

sentences.en: One inmate was found clinging to a rock outcropping
sentences.zh: 其中一名囚犯被发现紧紧抱住恶魔岛以西

sentences.en: 100 feet west of Alcatraz and recaptured.
sentences.zh: 100英尺处的岩石露头，并被重新抓获。

sentences.en: But most damaging to the prison was the discovery of the second escapee.
sentences.zh: 但对监狱打击最大的是第二名逃犯的被发现。

sentences.en: Teenagers walking along the beach at Fort Point near the Golden Gate Bridge found the unmoving body of the second escaped inmate.
sentences.zh: 几名沿着金门大桥附近克朗凯特堡海滩漫步的青少年发现了第二名越狱犯一动不动的尸体。

sentences.en: Believing he was dead, they contacted authorities, who were shocked to discover the inmate was actually still alive.
sentences.zh: 他们以为他死了，于是联系了当局，而当局震惊地发现这名囚犯其实还活着。

sentences.en: He had successfully swum across the bay from the prison.
sentences.zh: 他已经成功从监狱游过海湾来到了对岸。

sentences.en: This raised serious doubts over prison officials' previous claims that it was impossible for Morris or the Anglin brothers to have survived a swim to the mainland.
sentences.zh: 这引发了对监狱官员先前声称莫里斯或安格林兄弟不可能游到大陆的说法的严重质疑。

sentences.en: That ended up being the final escape attempt from Alcatraz prison.
sentences.zh: 这最终成了恶魔岛监狱的最后一次越狱企图。

sentences.en: Within weeks, the phase to close the prison permanently began.
sentences.zh: 几周内，永久关闭监狱的阶段就开始了。

sentences.en: Inmates were relocated to other state prisons in small groups, including Alan West, who was transferred to McNeil Island in Washington.
sentences.zh: 囚犯们被分批转移到其他州立监狱，其中包括阿兰·韦斯特，他被转移到了华盛顿的麦克尼尔岛。

sentences.en: He spent the remainder of his life in and out of prison before he died in 1978.
sentences.zh: 他在监狱里度过了余生，直到1978年去世。

sentences.en: Alcatraz closed its doors on March 21st, 1963, after 29 years of operation.
sentences.zh: 恶魔岛在运营29年后于1963年3月21日关闭。

sentences.en: 1,576 prisoners went through the prison during that time.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，共有1,576名囚犯被关押在该监狱。

sentences.en: 36 attempted to escape.
sentences.zh: 36人企图逃跑。

sentences.en: 23 were recaptured,
sentences.zh: 23人被重新抓获，

sentences.en: 6 were shot dead, and 4 were confirmed drowned in San Francisco Bay.
sentences.zh: 6人被枪杀，4人被证实溺水身亡于旧金山湾。

sentences.en: As for the other three, arrest warrants are still active for Frank Morris and the Anglin brothers, and they are still listed by the Marshals
sentences.zh: 至于另外三人，弗兰克·莫里斯和安格林兄弟的逮捕令仍然有效，他们仍然被法警列为

sentences.en: as Northern California's most wanted fugitives.
sentences.zh: 北加州通缉名单上的头号逃犯。

sentences.en: The investigation will continue until the escapees are arrested, confirmed deceased, or when they reach the age of 99.
sentences.zh: 调查将持续进行，直到这些逃犯被捕、确认死亡，或者他们年满99岁。

sentences.en: If the men were alive today,
sentences.zh: 如果这些人今天还活着，

sentences.en: Frank Morris would be in his early 90s, and the Anglin brothers would be in their late 80s.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克·莫里斯将年过九旬，而安格林兄弟也将年近九旬。

sentences.zh: 1,576名囚犯以及第一天的

sentences.en: 2,576 prisoners all over the P Steps
sentences.zh: 2,576名囚犯遍布P台阶

sentences.zh: 1,576名囚犯依然遍布全监狱
